recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed for FHIR-18408 unless the out-of-build CDA profile is later reactivated and separately reviewed.
issue_request: FHIR-18408 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 FHIR-core DomainResource change request to remove the comma from the DomainResource.modifierExtension definition phrase "not part of the basic definition of the resource, and that modifies the".
initial_application: The issue was applied by git commit 6ad6a3d3cc780eb88ca09c6ebc2c10e626fd3ec0, which changed source/domainresource/domainresource-spreadsheet.xml from "resource, and that modifies" to "resource and that modifies". Later commit 33b409a4b6d544598262f2f074ebb4b6dc466157 migrated the DomainResource source to source/domainresource/structuredefinition-DomainResource.xml and preserved the corrected no-comma wording.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists DomainResource as an active abstract infrastructure resource. A scoped search found the old comma only in source/profiles/cda.profile.xml, but the cda profile entry in fhir.ini is commented out, so that stale profile text is not part of the current DomainResource build scope. Quoted Zulip and Confluence searches found no contrary community evidence.
reconciliation: No source change was made. source/domainresource/structuredefinition-DomainResource.xml already says "not part of the basic definition of the resource and that modifies" for DomainResource.modifierExtension.
